svg.title: See2Hear orchestration state transitions
svg.desc: The eight SearchCoordinator phases and their transitions, followed by detailed search, language, voting, cancellation, and recovery flows. Listening includes the complete multi-turn conversation.
svg.text: Search transitions, spoken feedback, and UI-controlled sessions

g.text: State names match SearchCoordinator.Phase. Each search round starts by awaiting one complete language query.
Clarify for as many turns as needed.
Detect and track an eligible sign.
start / reminder / lost sign / wrong gate
Stop, backgrounding, interruption, or a fatal error enters stopping from any active phase.
Button Stop clears isEnabled. Interruption and fatal errors retain it. Cleanup selects stopped or suspended(reason).
Round cancellation and recoverable search errors return to listening. Each completed round begins a fresh conversation.
Recovery requires an enabled session and available resources. A recovery request during stopping waits for cleanup.
Clarification speech and model loading remain within listening. The speaking phase handles coordinator-issued search feedback.
A. Listen and acquire a target
Await a complete query, then search. Every 10 s, announce stillSearching at a frame boundary and resume after playback.
Keep the query ID and category.
Pick an eligible box; apply low vibration.
No eligible box or target lost.
Third centered observation of the same
candidate. Lock its track for this batch.
Centering requires the box center inside the middle 24% on each axis, box overlap (IoU) ≥ 0.40, and successive observations ≤ 0.5 s apart.
B. Read five fresh frames while the two-second pulse runs
Start the two branches together for each attempt. Once one branch finishes, it waits for the other. Cancel or interruption preempts both.
Use this frame’s box for readSign
Same value in ≥3 of 5 wins a field.
On split votes, mark the field unknown.
Keep this verdict until the pulse finishes.
Both pulse and vote are complete.
Choose the speech or search action.
Track matching uses box overlap (IoU ≥ 0.40). After speech, re-anchor without the 0.5 s age limit. Every retry uses five new frames.
Compare raw gate digits before filtering on the requested ID. For a gate, take distance votes only from frames supporting the winning digit.
C. Select the announcement and wait for playback
Each row follows the pulse and vote. Await playback before continuing; the UI Stop button cancels the session.
Requested digit wins at least 3 of 5.
Speak target and available distance. See Playback detail.
Same candidate identified on ≥3 of 5 frames.
Speak the sign and available details
No arrow majority → pass nil; speech omits the direction.
Another digit wins at least 3 of 5 votes.
Name the observed gate, then the requested gate.
No digit wins at least 3 of 5 votes.
Ask the user to hold the phone still
Finish the prompt before sampling the next five frames.
Three total attempts, including the initial read.
“I couldn’t read the sign.” Invite a new request.
D. UI Stop, interrupt, and recover
These transitions apply across the active states, including the haptic timer, inference, silent waiting, and speech playback.
listening tasks and timers. Apply haptics off.
Release active resources and discard late results.
Stop capture; await cancelled work before Start.
Stopped until the user presses Start.
Resume only if enabled and resources are ready. Recovery requested during cleanup resumes the session after stopping completes.
Errors while listening or unavailable resources → stopping → suspended. Other round errors → listening. See recovery details above.
Fewer than 3 matched frames: announce lost sight, reset attempts, and reacquire. No distance majority → pass nil.
Vision supplies per-frame predictions; Orchestration owns tracking, batches, votes, timers and routing. Haptic already supports off, low and high.
Language detail · calls from A and C
Phase stays listening during capture, model loading, inference, and clarification speech. A complete query releases the await.
Say “Loading the language model. Please wait.”
Screen: Loading model…; Stop remains available.
Load the model; process the utterance.
Reuse the cached model on later requests.
Listening, Searching or Next attempt exit.
Language status shows listening, understanding, or speaking. Each model turn uses the full message history. Stop awaits cleanup.
Three attempts per candidate; fresh votes per attempt. Re-anchor after speech. Wrong gates stay suppressed while visible.
